entries.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
entries.transliteration: Bismillāh, tawakkaltu ‘alallāh, lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
entries.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no power and no strength except through Allah.

entries.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
entries.transliteration: A‘ūdhu bi-kalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
entries.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

entries.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
entries.transliteration: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa illam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn.
entries.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

entries.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
entries.translation: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
entries.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka ‘ilman nāfi‘an, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan.
entries.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

entries.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
entries.transliteration: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata a‘yunin waj‘alnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā.
entries.translation: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and children comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
entries.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’alukal-‘afwa wal-‘āfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah.
entries.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

entries.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
entries.transliteration: Allāhumma Antas-Salāmu wa minkas-salām, tabārakta yā Dhal-Jalāli wal-Ikrām.
entries.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.
